decisive_items: provisional diagnosis of an auricular malignant tumor
response.rationale: Pediatric vascular friable aural mass with atypical cells and a provisional malignant diagnosis strongly favors rhabdomyosarcoma; granulomatous inflammation may be reactive, and the other entities are less consistent with marked arterial vascularity and malignant cytology.

rejected.why: Granulomatous inflammation and purulent sores suggest infection, but atypical cells, malignant provisional diagnosis, and marked vascularity are not explained by mycobacterial infection.
